policies.sweep20: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at20%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.cap40: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at40%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.active20: monthly closed source target contains positive non-BIL weight =>20% book share, otherwise zero; remainder reserve; explicit recapitalization when active
policies.scope: shares frozen at original monthly closed decision and filled after original delay; continuous cap not claimed; original source target stream unchanged; gross per-book fees including opposite fills
policies.profit: capital transfers sum zero and excluded from profit; three initial shares20/20/60; no new yield sources

mechanisms.g20: Carry last explicit sparse source per book; exclude source-zero held complement from binding joint budget; at fill veto positive target when latest closed source is zero, assign BIL remainder; same dated lag, monthly funding, actual gross book fees. Veto in full/scoped acquisitions may exit existing units before a later queued exit; no continuous investment cap claim.
mechanisms.c60: Copy rebound_half nominal targets and selection exactly; only Sunday satellite refresh. local variants recover/refill the triggered core/satellite family without coupled core override; simultaneous families union. Suppress only positive requested topups of already-owned assets whose prefee increase/owned open value is <=10% or25%; freeze suppressed units, no redistribution; original reductions, zeros, risk gate and cash solver retained.
mechanisms.protected: Initial pre-start funding, recovered and next-close continuing assets bypass topup filter; band changes no source target, state threshold, Sunday, lag or fee rate. Bands applied only at acquisition, not a sell inaction region or theoretically optimal cost rule.
mechanisms.objective: C60 all four cells CAGR strictly higher, drawdown no worse, closed net win rate strictly higher than rebound_half; separately compare historical ranking leader mature_rebound_half. G20 zero source buys at both decision and latest-fill closed source is correctness gate, not return gate. Original historical selection policy unchanged.
mechanisms.stop: One frozen9-candidate/9-control/72-curve study. No result-conditioned band, timing, state threshold, fit, new source, forward window or rescue.

selection_policy.primary: maximize minimum cash_excess_sharpe across all four cost/delay cells
selection_policy.ties: minimum CAGR, worst drawdown, lower maximum turnover, stable version ID

data_scope: Same frozen historical inputs through old endpoints; no new source, fit, P3 outer, production, account or service change.
